dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.en: "Nya~!"
dialogues.text: "Nya~!"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp:
「おぉ、どした？　ご主人様は一緒じゃないの
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Oh? What's wrong? Why aren't you with your master?"
dialogues.text: "Oh? What's wrong? Why aren't you with your master?"

dialogues.jp:
特に用事があるわけではなく、ただブラブラと
体育館裏に足を運んだ俺を出迎えてくれたのは
うたまるだ。
dialogues.en:
With nothing special to do, I wandered aimlessly to the back
of the gym and had a chance meeting with Utamaru.
dialogues.text:
With nothing special to do, I wandered aimlessly to the back
of the gym and had a chance meeting with Utamaru.

dialogues.jp:
必死に何かを訴えかけてくるうたまる。……だ
が、悲しいかな、俺はうたまると語らう能力を
持ち合わせていない。
dialogues.en:
It was desperately appealing to me for something. ...But
sadly, it's not easy for us to converse.
dialogues.text:
It was desperately appealing to me for something. ...But
sadly, it's not easy for us to converse.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃっ、にゃにゃっ、にゃ〜にゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Nya, nyanya, nya~nya~"
dialogues.text: "Nya, nyanya, nya~nya~"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなうたまる……。さくらのようにお前
　が言っていることを理解してやれればいいん
　だがなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry, Utamaru... but Sakura is the only one who can
understand what you're saying."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry, Utamaru... but Sakura is the only one who can
understand what you're saying."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Unya~"
dialogues.text: "Unya~"

dialogues.jp:
まあ、さくらの翻訳は、うたまるの真意を伝え
切れているかどうかと言われると、いささか疑
問ではあるのだが。
dialogues.en:
Well, even with Sakura translating, I doubt she really knows
what Utamaru is trying to convey anyway.
dialogues.text:
Well, even with Sakura translating, I doubt she really knows
what Utamaru is trying to convey anyway.

dialogues.jp:
小さな友達をなでてやろうと、うたまるに手を
のばしたそのとき、うたまるがピョンと飛び跳
ねて、俺のふところに飛び込んできた。
dialogues.en:
I spread out my hand to my little friend, and it jumped at
the invitation to bury itself inside my coat.
dialogues.text:
I spread out my hand to my little friend, and it jumped at
the invitation to bury itself inside my coat.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Nya~"
dialogues.text: "Nya~"

dialogues.jp:
間髪を入れずに背後から駆け寄ってくる人物の
気配が。
dialogues.en:
At practically the same time, I sensed someone approaching
from behind.
dialogues.text:
At practically the same time, I sensed someone approaching
from behind.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「お……朝倉か」
dialogues.en: "Ah... Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ah... Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんですか先生？　こんなところで」
dialogues.en: "What a surprise, sensei! What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What a surprise, sensei! What are you doing here?"

dialogues.jp:
息を整えながら、俺の質問に答える暦先生。そ
の表情は、あからさまに落胆している。
dialogues.en:
Her face was one of dejection. She took a bit of time to
steady her breathing, then answered.
dialogues.text:
Her face was one of dejection. She took a bit of time to
steady her breathing, then answered.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや……さっき、例の白い猫を見かけてな。
　この『｛チョー／兆｝強力捕獲用睡眠剤Ｚ』で眠らせて、
　捕獲しようと思ったんだが」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing... I saw a little white cat earleir, so I thought
I'd use this Super-Strength Entrapment Sleeping Pill Z to
capture it..."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing... I saw a little white cat earleir, so I thought
I'd use this Super-Strength Entrapment Sleeping Pill Z to
capture it..."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生の手には、怪しげな雰囲気を醸し出して
いる小型の注射器が二、三本握られている。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei was holding two or three suspicious-looking
syringes.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei was holding two or three suspicious-looking
syringes.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「なかなかにすばしっこくてな……。ターゲッ
　トロストってやつだ」
dialogues.en:
"That thing was pretty quick, though... and I lost my
target."
dialogues.text:
"That thing was pretty quick, though... and I lost my
target."

dialogues.jp: ったく……この人は。
dialogues.en: Buh... this woman.
dialogues.text: Buh... this woman.

dialogues.jp:
今にはじまったことじゃないが、本当に「不思
議なこと」に目がないな。
dialogues.en:
This isn't the first time, either. There's no such thing as
"unusual" in her eyes.
dialogues.text:
This isn't the first time, either. There's no such thing as
"unusual" in her eyes.

dialogues.jp: しかし、どうりでうたまるも必死なわけだ。
dialogues.en: But, now I see why Utamaru was so frightened.
dialogues.text: But, now I see why Utamaru was so frightened.

dialogues.jp:
先生に捕まったら命の保証はまったくないから
なぁ〜。同情するぜ、うたまる。
dialogues.en:
Once caught by Koyomi-sensei, there's no way to guarantee
you'd come out unscathed... I sympathize, Utamaru.
dialogues.text:
Once caught by Koyomi-sensei, there's no way to guarantee
you'd come out unscathed... I sympathize, Utamaru.

dialogues.jp:
ふっと視線を自分のふところに下ろして、うた
まるの無事を確認する。
dialogues.en:
I took a quick look down at my chest to re-assure myself of
Utamaru's safety.
dialogues.text:
I took a quick look down at my chest to re-assure myself of
Utamaru's safety.

dialogues.jp: ……がこれが裏目に出た。
dialogues.en: ...But that backfired.
dialogues.text: ...But that backfired.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうかしたか？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's there?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's there?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: （やべっ）
dialogues.en: "(Oh crap.)"
dialogues.text: "(Oh crap.)"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉、あんたもしかして……。ちょっと上着
　脱いでみろ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, you better not be... take off your coat."
dialogues.text: "Asakura, you better not be... take off your coat."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
（や、やっぱ気づかれた……さすがに勘が鋭い
　な……）
dialogues.en: "(S, she's noticed... her perception is sharp...)"
dialogues.text: "(S, she's noticed... her perception is sharp...)"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「い、イヤ〜ん、先生。こんなところでそんな
　｛はれんち／破廉恥｝なこと……」
dialogues.en:
"I, I caaaan't, sensei. Doing such an immoral thing in a
place like this..."
dialogues.text:
"I, I caaaan't, sensei. Doing such an immoral thing in a
place like this..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いいから脱いでみろ」
dialogues.en: "Hurry up and take it off."
dialogues.text: "Hurry up and take it off."

dialogues.jp:
マイッチングポーズを取る俺をよそに、じわじ
わと間合いを詰めてくる暦先生。このままじゃ
マズい。うたまるが捕獲されてしまう……。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi quickly saw through my delay tactics. This is bad. If
Utamaru gets taken...
dialogues.text:
Koyomi quickly saw through my delay tactics. This is bad. If
Utamaru gets taken...

dialogues.jp: （うたまる、逃げろ）
dialogues.en: "(Utamaru, run!)"
dialogues.text: "(Utamaru, run!)"

dialogues.jp:
出来る限り小声でささやいたつもりだったが、
先生にはそんな小細工も無駄だったようで。
dialogues.en:
I whispered to the poor little thing, knowing full well that
Koyomi-sensei wouldn't be tricked so easily.
dialogues.text:
I whispered to the poor little thing, knowing full well that
Koyomi-sensei wouldn't be tricked so easily.

dialogues.jp:
俺の合図とほぼ同時に、ふところから勢いよく
飛び出るうたまる。
dialogues.en: At my signal, Utamaru jumped out from my coat pocket.
dialogues.text: At my signal, Utamaru jumped out from my coat pocket.

dialogues.jp: もちろん、先生がその機を逃すはずもない。
dialogues.en: Of course, Koyomi-sensei saw through it easily.
dialogues.text: Of course, Koyomi-sensei saw through it easily.

dialogues.jp: キラ〜ンと光を放つ先生の眼鏡。
dialogues.en: Her glasses sparkled momentarily.
dialogues.text: Her glasses sparkled momentarily.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そこだっ！」
dialogues.en: "How's this!"
dialogues.text: "How's this!"

dialogues.jp:
刹那、先生の手から手裏剣のごとく、『ちょー
なんたらかんたら』が放たれる。
dialogues.en:
In a flash, like a set of shuriken, she threw the
Super-whatevercrapitwas out.
dialogues.text:
In a flash, like a set of shuriken, she threw the
Super-whatevercrapitwas out.

dialogues.jp: ブスッ！！
dialogues.en: --*stab!"
dialogues.text: --*stab!"

dialogues.jp: 「アウチッ！！」
dialogues.en: "Ouch!"
dialogues.text: "Ouch!"

dialogues.jp: 見事命中！
dialogues.en: Amazing accuracy!
dialogues.text: Amazing accuracy!

dialogues.jp: ……俺のオシリに。
dialogues.en: ...Right into my asscheek.
dialogues.text: ...Right into my asscheek.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……げっ……マズいなこりゃ」
dialogues.en: "...Guh... this is bad."
dialogues.text: "...Guh... this is bad."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
（な、何がマズいんですか先生……。俺、大丈
　夫なんですよね？　別に命に別状はないです
　よね……）
dialogues.en:
"(W, what do you mean bad, sensei... I'm perfectly fine,
right...)"
dialogues.text:
"(W, what do you mean bad, sensei... I'm perfectly fine,
right...)"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「猫はひとまずあきらめて……、ひとまずあそ
　こに……」
dialogues.en: "I'd give up the cat for now... for now, over there..."
dialogues.text: "I'd give up the cat for now... for now, over there..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: （あそこってドコですか先生……）
dialogues.en: "(Over there is where, sensei...)"
dialogues.text: "(Over there is where, sensei...)"

dialogues.jp:
遠のく意識…………。あぁ、俺、これからどう
なるんだろう……。
dialogues.en:
My senses started escaping me... ahh, where am I going
now...
dialogues.text:
My senses started escaping me... ahh, where am I going
now...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん……、ついにあなたが目覚めるときが
　きました……。目を覚ましてください。世界
　はアナタの助けを必要としています……」
dialogues.en:
"Nii-san... awaken once more... please awaken. The world
needs you..."
dialogues.text:
"Nii-san... awaken once more... please awaken. The world
needs you..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふへっ……」
dialogues.en: "Hooeh..."
dialogues.text: "Hooeh..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「さあ起きて」
dialogues.en: "Now, awaken."
dialogues.text: "Now, awaken."

dialogues.jp:
ばっと目覚める俺。すると、そこは自分が寝て
いるベッド以外、何もない質素な部屋だった。
dialogues.en:
I awoke in an instant. In the room I was sleeping in, there
was nothing except a bed.
dialogues.text:
I awoke in an instant. In the room I was sleeping in, there
was nothing except a bed.

dialogues.jp:
部屋には窓もなく、ただひとつ出入り口と思わ
れる扉が存在している。
dialogues.en:
The room had no window, and only one door to go in and out
of.
dialogues.text:
The room had no window, and only one door to go in and out
of.

dialogues.jp: （ここはどこだ？）
dialogues.en: "(Where is this?)"
dialogues.text: "(Where is this?)"

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、命に別状はなかったようだ。
dialogues.en: In any case, it seems my life isn't in danger.
dialogues.text: In any case, it seems my life isn't in danger.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、わけわからん夢を見たな……。ゲーム
のやりすぎだろうか？
dialogues.en:
But I seem to having some odd dream... it's a bit like a
game of sorts?
dialogues.text:
But I seem to having some odd dream... it's a bit like a
game of sorts?

dialogues.jp:
俺を起こしてくれたのは音夢だよな……。世界
を救うやら、ナニやら言っていたような……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was the one who woke me up... what was she babbling on
about, saving the world and all...
dialogues.text:
Nemu was the one who woke me up... what was she babbling on
about, saving the world and all...

dialogues.jp: とりあえずこの身が健在であることを確認。
dialogues.en: Anyway, I do a quick check of my health.
dialogues.text: Anyway, I do a quick check of my health.

dialogues.jp: ……大丈夫のようだ。
dialogues.en: ...I seem okay.
dialogues.text: ...I seem okay.

dialogues.jp: （さてどうしようか？）
dialogues.en: "(What should I do now?)"
dialogues.text: "(What should I do now?)"

dialogues.jp: 小考すること十数秒。
dialogues.en: I thought for 10 seconds.
dialogues.text: I thought for 10 seconds.

dialogues.jp:
「……そういや、今、試験中だった……。こん
　な訳分からんところで、ちんたらしている暇
　はな〜い！」
dialogues.en:
"...This is right in the middle of the examinations
period... I don't have time to waste in a place like this!"
dialogues.text:
"...This is right in the middle of the examinations
period... I don't have time to waste in a place like this!"

dialogues.jp:
覚悟を決め、扉の前に歩み寄り、ドアノブに手
をのばす。
dialogues.en:
Making up my mind, I walk to the door and place my hand on
the doorknob.
dialogues.text:
Making up my mind, I walk to the door and place my hand on
the doorknob.

dialogues.jp: ギギギギギ………………。
dialogues.en: --*beebeebeebeep*
dialogues.text: --*beebeebeebeep*

dialogues.jp:
さしたる抵抗も見せずに、お世辞にもいい気の
しない音を立てて、ゆっくりと扉が開く。
dialogues.en:
As if scanning the amount of resistance I had in me, it
eventually opened.
dialogues.text:
As if scanning the amount of resistance I had in me, it
eventually opened.

dialogues.jp: まずはひと安心といったとところか。
dialogues.en: That worried me for a second.
dialogues.text: That worried me for a second.

dialogues.jp:
時間も惜しいので、俺は早速、部屋の外へ出て
みることにした。
dialogues.en: With time a commodity, I rushed out of the room.
dialogues.text: With time a commodity, I rushed out of the room.

dialogues.jp: コツコツ――。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatter*

dialogues.jp: コツコツコツ――。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatter*

dialogues.jp: コツコツコツコツコツ……。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatterpatter*

dialogues.jp: しばらく一本道の通路が続く。
dialogues.en: I kept running down the lone path.
dialogues.text: I kept running down the lone path.

dialogues.jp:
何分歩いただろうか……。俺の周囲を囲んでい
る背景にようやく変化が現れる。
dialogues.en:
As I kept running... the background scenery began to change
as a fork appeared.
dialogues.text:
As I kept running... the background scenery began to change
as a fork appeared.

dialogues.jp: 分かれ道だ……。どうする？
dialogues.en: This seems familiar... what should I do?
dialogues.text: This seems familiar... what should I do?

dialogues.jp: 俺は直感を頼りに右へ進むことにした。
dialogues.en:
Putting what little faith I had in my intution to the test,
I ran down the right road.
dialogues.text:
Putting what little faith I had in my intution to the test,
I ran down the right road.

dialogues.jp: コツコツ――。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatter*

dialogues.jp: コツコツコツ――。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatter*

dialogues.jp: コツコツコツコツコツ……。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatterpatter*

dialogues.jp:
しばらく進むと、ツンとした、嫌悪感満点の臭
気が辺りに漂いはじめる。それは、よくある例
えを使うならば、腐った卵のような……。
dialogues.en:
Pressing forward, I detected a repugnant smell. Like rotten
eggs...
dialogues.text:
Pressing forward, I detected a repugnant smell. Like rotten
eggs...

dialogues.jp: （腐った卵の臭いを嗅いだことないけどさ）
dialogues.en: "(With some cooks at home, I'm used to that smell...)"
dialogues.text: "(With some cooks at home, I'm used to that smell...)"

dialogues.jp:
このまま進むと危険な気がしないでもない。俺
の頼れる｛アテカン／第七感｝が、ビンビンに脳内に訴えかけ
てくる。『危険！　逝っちゃうよボク！』と。
dialogues.en:
If I continue on any further, I'd probably be in danger. My
seventh sense is pleading me "Stop! You'd die!".
dialogues.text:
If I continue on any further, I'd probably be in danger. My
seventh sense is pleading me "Stop! You'd die!".

dialogues.jp:
しかしその一方で、心の中に眠っていた熱き血
潮が『行け！　行くんだオレ！』と、俺をまだ
見ぬ冒険へと駆り立てる……。
dialogues.en:
But previously-hidden burning blood in my heart was telling
me "Go! Keep going!" Spurring me on into the unknown risk...
dialogues.text:
But previously-hidden burning blood in my heart was telling
me "Go! Keep going!" Spurring me on into the unknown risk...

dialogues.jp: これが漢の｛さが／性｝というものか。
dialogues.en: This is quite a pickle.
dialogues.text: This is quite a pickle.

dialogues.jp:
……さて、どうしよう？　もはやここまで来る
と、試験のことなんてどうでもよく思えてくる
が。
dialogues.en: ...Now, what should I do?
dialogues.text: ...Now, what should I do?

dialogues.jp:
そのまま進んで、漢として名を上げるか？　そ
れとも、ここは冷静になって、今来た道を戻る
か？
dialogues.en:
There's no point turning back. I can only go forward from
here.
dialogues.text:
There's no point turning back. I can only go forward from
here.

dialogues.jp: コツコツ――。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatter*

dialogues.jp: コツコツコツ――。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatter*

dialogues.jp: コツコツコツコツコツ……。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatterpatter*

dialogues.jp: またまたしばらく前進。
dialogues.en: I continued forward on the path.
dialogues.text: I continued forward on the path.

dialogues.jp: ――バタン！！
dialogues.en: "--*bang!*
dialogues.text: "--*bang!*

dialogues.jp:
ふいに、足下にあるはずの地面の感覚が消失す
る。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, my feet stopped hitting the ground.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, my feet stopped hitting the ground.

dialogues.jp:
落とし穴だ――と自分が気づくときには、時す
でに遅し。
dialogues.en: Before I could react, I was falling down a hole.
dialogues.text: Before I could react, I was falling down a hole.

dialogues.jp:
穴の底に広がる、煮えたぎるマグマに着水？
するまでにさしたる時間はかからなかった。
dialogues.en:
Is that boiling magma at the bottom? I don't have time for
this...
dialogues.text:
Is that boiling magma at the bottom? I don't have time for
this...

dialogues.jp: 「し、試験を受けないと……」
dialogues.en: "W, won't be able to take the exams..."
dialogues.text: "W, won't be able to take the exams..."

dialogues.jp: ―　ＧＡＭＥ　ＯＶＥＲ　―
dialogues.en: - GAME OVER -
dialogues.text: - GAME OVER -

dialogues.jp: コツコツ――。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatter*

dialogues.jp: コツコツコツ――。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatter*

dialogues.jp: コツコツコツコツコツ……。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatterpatter*

dialogues.jp: 身の危険を察知し、今来た道を戻ることにする。
dialogues.en: My mind won out in the end, and I started running back.
dialogues.text: My mind won out in the end, and I started running back.

dialogues.jp:
俺にはこの後、試験を受けなければならないと
いう使命があるのだ。
dialogues.en: I still have exams that I have to take.
dialogues.text: I still have exams that I have to take.

dialogues.jp: 漢など気取っている余裕はない。
dialogues.en: This isn't a matter of foolhardy hotbloodedness.
dialogues.text: This isn't a matter of foolhardy hotbloodedness.

dialogues.jp:
俺は最初の分岐路まで戻ると、もう一方の道を
進むことにした。
dialogues.en: I returned to the fork, and took the other path.
dialogues.text: I returned to the fork, and took the other path.

dialogues.jp: コツコツ――。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatter*

dialogues.jp: コツコツコツ――。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatter*

dialogues.jp: コツコツコツコツコツ……。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatterpatter*

dialogues.jp: ……さくらが現れた！
dialogues.en: ...Wild SAKURA appeared!
dialogues.text: ...Wild SAKURA appeared!

dialogues.jp: コマンド？
dialogues.en: Command?
dialogues.text: Command?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「私は、マジョ・ヨシノサクラ。そこんとこよ
　ろしく」
dialogues.en: "MY NAME IS WITCH YOSHINO SAKURA. NICE TO MEET YOU."
dialogues.text: "MY NAME IS WITCH YOSHINO SAKURA. NICE TO MEET YOU."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「せっかくお会いしたのにザンネンですが、こ
　こはまだ、アナタの来るべきところではあり
　ません。引き返すのです……」
dialogues.en:
"UNFORTUNATELY, THE PRINCESS IS IN ANOTHER CASTLE. I WILL
RETURN YOU NOW."
dialogues.text:
"UNFORTUNATELY, THE PRINCESS IS IN ANOTHER CASTLE. I WILL
RETURN YOU NOW."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっ……ちょっと待ってくれ！　ここは一
　体何処なんだ？　教えてくれぇ」
dialogues.en: "W... wait a minute! Where the hell is this place? Tell me!"
dialogues.text: "W... wait a minute! Where the hell is this place? Tell me!"

dialogues.jp: [name]は武器を装備していない！
dialogues.en: [name] doesn't have that weapon equipped!
dialogues.text: [name] doesn't have that weapon equipped!

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜、うにゃ〜にゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Unya~, unya~nya~"
dialogues.text: "Unya~, unya~nya~"

dialogues.jp: うたまるの鳴き声が聞こえてくる……。
dialogues.en: I could hear Utamaru's pitiful crying...
dialogues.text: I could hear Utamaru's pitiful crying...

dialogues.jp: 「……ふがっ」
dialogues.en: "...Gwah."
dialogues.text: "...Gwah."

dialogues.jp: ふと我に返り、上半身を起こす。
dialogues.en: I felt like I just woke up from a deep slumber.
dialogues.text: I felt like I just woke up from a deep slumber.

dialogues.jp:
「ん……？　ここは……。俺、さっきまで何し
　てたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm...? This is... what was I doing just now...?"
dialogues.text: "Hm...? This is... what was I doing just now...?"

dialogues.jp: 体に極度の疲労感を感じる……。
dialogues.en: I feel so very tired...
dialogues.text: I feel so very tired...

dialogues.jp:
（よく覚えてないが……、とても疲れる夢を見
　ていたような、そうでないような）
dialogues.en:
"(I don't seem to be able to remember... but it was
definitely a tiring dream...)"
dialogues.text:
"(I don't seem to be able to remember... but it was
definitely a tiring dream...)"

dialogues.jp:
「……やべっ！　こんなところで時間食ってる
　暇ねえよ！　試験始まっちまう！」
dialogues.en:
"...Gah! I don't even have time to eat now! The exam is
gonna start!"
dialogues.text:
"...Gah! I don't even have time to eat now! The exam is
gonna start!"

dialogues.jp:
俺はうたまるに起こしてくれた礼を言い、その
場を後にした。
dialogues.en:
I thanked Utamaru for waking me up, and rushed back to
class.
dialogues.text:
I thanked Utamaru for waking me up, and rushed back to
class.

dialogues.jp: ◆危ない！え、俺が！？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Danger! Eh, Me!?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Danger! Eh, Me!?◆

dialogues.jp:
うたまるを体育館裏で見つけた。ちょうどそこ
へタイミング悪く、うたまる捕獲にご執心の暦
先生がやってきた。
dialogues.en:
I found Utamaru at the back of the gym, and unluckily
enough, also ran into Koyomi-sensei, who wanted to capture
him.
dialogues.text:
I found Utamaru at the back of the gym, and unluckily
enough, also ran into Koyomi-sensei, who wanted to capture
him.

dialogues.jp:
対うたまる用の怪しげな武器は、見事に俺に命
中し、俺は気を失った。
dialogues.en:
Using the anti-Utamaru weapon on me instead with amazing
accuracy, I lost conciousness.
dialogues.text:
Using the anti-Utamaru weapon on me instead with amazing
accuracy, I lost conciousness.

dialogues.jp:
目覚めると、どうにも不思議な場所にいた。妙
なダンジョンを、ゲームのキャラクターよろし
く、進んでいく。
dialogues.en:
When I awoke, I was in a strange place. I continued through
the dungeon-like place like a game character.
dialogues.text:
When I awoke, I was in a strange place. I continued through
the dungeon-like place like a game character.

dialogues.jp:
｛うよきょくせつ／紆余曲折｝を経て、なんとか俺は生還したようだ。
全ては夢だったのか……何にせよ、俺は試験の
ことを思い出し、慌てて教室へと向かった。
dialogues.en:
Despite all the twists and turns, I somehow returned alive.
Was it all a dream...? ...Was something I didn't have time
to think about, as I remembered about my exams and hastily
returned to my classroom.
dialogues.text:
Despite all the twists and turns, I somehow returned alive.
Was it all a dream...? ...Was something I didn't have time
to think about, as I remembered about my exams and hastily
returned to my classroom.
